view.description: Daily concert watch for artists from your Spotify Liked Songs and top playlists. Flags shows and new tour announcements in regions you care about, emails only when something new drops, and rebuilds the artist list monthly.

memory.content: Check daily for concerts by artists from Spotify Liked Songs and Me Likey / top-songs style playlists in the user's chosen regions (example setup: Nevada, California, Arizona, or Alberta). Email when new matches appear; stay quiet if nothing new.
Always also track standing extras the user names (bands beyond Spotify likes) for shows in the chosen regions.
Include tour announcements (not only already-listed dates) when liked bands announce tours or onsales touching the chosen regions.
Rebuild the liked-bands artist list monthly (1st of the month) from Spotify Liked Songs and Me Likey / top playlists, keeping any standing extras the user named.
Needs a Spotify connector that can read Liked Songs and playlist tracks. No official Spotify marketplace plugin was available in this setup; a custom Spotify MCP server provided that access.
Songkick metro pages are useful search sources for target cities; look up current metro IDs per city rather than hard-coding stale ones.
